description:
Why Do We Shiver When We're Cold? The Muscle Engine! — You step out of the warm shower on a winter morning, and your whole body starts chattering and vibrating like a drum!
Kids science answer for "why do we shiver when cold kids science" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

When your core body temperature dips, your brain commands muscles to twitch rapidly up to 30 times a second, turning movement into warming body heat.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
